content.short: Privasea is a privacy-preserving AI compute network using FHE to process encrypted data without decryption.
content.description:
Privasea is a pioneering Decentralized Physical Infrastructure Network (DePIN) designed to provide high-performance AI compute power while maintaining total data privacy. Utilizing advanced Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) technology, the platform enables AI models to perform complex computations on encrypted data without ever decrypting it. This ensures that sensitive information remains completely secure and inaccessible to the compute providers or the network itself, fulfilling the most rigorous data protection standards.

Designed for AI developers and researchers, Privasea provides a robust and scalable alternative to centralized cloud services for processing high-value or regulated data. The network is powered by the $PRAI token, which facilitates compute resource allocation and incentivizes node providers who contribute to the ecosystem. Through its commitment to privacy-preserving innovation and decentralized compute, Privasea is building the essential framework for a more secure and confidential intelligence economy, where data ownership is a primary utility.
